notes.text: This landscape listing sheet contains two staggered diagrams. The upper diagram places two X-minus-S-type group expressions over barred and unbarred M expressions, with Gamma and terminal 1 labels. The transcription records their drawn links without inferring exactness or repairing direction from algebra.

The lower diagram has hatted group symbols, hatted modular T labels, and the written operators Autlac and Autextlac with circle and exclamation marks. Its far-right Sigma labels are detached. The word below the last horizontal span is read traces; no independent brace is supplied.

The two lower-left membership formulas are on separate lines. The first has uppercase K, and the second ends with G carrying low xi. The bottom middle group has hatted Sigma with a separate upper-right wave, a vertically oriented equality to barred Sigma below, and a separate plain Sigma on the right.

The cancelled lower-diagram line retains a partial incoming fragment and X, with its older index unresolved. The cancelled predecessor above-left of the bottom live Sigma retains a low g. These are partial readings of struck ink, not reconstructions supplied from the mathematical setting.

Printed IBM logos, the printed 6-to-0 edge sequence, footer 2975 – 132, and pencil 32 are retained. The pencil hand is unnamed. Pale mirrored listing characters showing through are not text on this face; the detached small spot beside the upper middle leading 1 is treated as an incidental point without a syntactic role and is not transcribed.

This first-pass work establishes transcription candidates only. No mathematical assertion was proved, re-proved, or computed. The common group notation and main's communicated already-inspected graphic comparison were used to settle the ten non-contrastive live group graphs as pi; no new image was opened for that decision. A mathematical expectation was not used to repair a clearly contrary letter or arrow.

The initial ten Pi/pi alternatives reflected wide caps and relatively straight legs, not ten independent source distinctions. The page offers no separate clear capital-Pi comparator. Main identified the same flat-crossbar pi hand in already-inspected group examples on029–031 and the same pi_1 / genus-puncture group notation here. The candidate therefore adopts pi consistently; the local shape observations remain in physical_indices and this report rather than multiplying alphabet doubts.

Main excludes the pale horizontal trace between the second X index and S as non-textual. The first expression has an inked set-minus; the second has no secure blue separator. Mathematical parallelism is not used to fill the gap. The first-X index preference is xi/g because its open upper turn differs from the page's closed-bowl g indices; uncertainty remains. The second reduced index retains j/xi.

raw_difference_disposition: All 47 packet raw differences were inspected against the original, native halves and the one crop for each unresolved locus. Material readings are recorded in changes; pure grid/macro/font differences are excluded. H editorial notes are not source prose, but every described deletion, brace, detached label and orientation was checked. Agreements were checked as well, producing a full physical-index/edge inventory. The normalized raw diff missed uppercase K, which is explicitly collated. The ten live pi graphs were checked individually but show no local alphabet contrast; consistent pi is retained after main's communicated existing graphic comparison, so there are no alphabet-change rows for them.
